headline.zh: 民主党横扫国会，伊朗战争成共和党败因
headline.en: Democrats sweep Congress as the Iran war sinks Republicans

lede.zh: 美国中期选举中，民主党同时拿下众议院和参议院，连特朗普和副总统万斯都承认伊朗战争伤了共和党。华尔街以道指大涨约1500点回应，而选民在几乎所有涉及数据中心的投票中都说了“不”，给AI基建热潮泼了一盆冷水。与此同时，俄军袭击乌克兰援助点致40人死亡，OpenAI则继续为Codex收购工具公司。
lede.en: Democrats took both the House and the Senate in the US midterms, and even President Trump and Vice President Vance conceded the Iran war hurt Republicans. Wall Street cheered with a roughly 1,500-point Dow rally, while voters rejected data centers in nearly every ballot measure, a cold shower for the AI building boom. Elsewhere, a Russian strike on a Ukrainian aid site killed 40, and OpenAI kept shopping for Codex tools.

headline.zh: 美国投票日，AI 的账单摊开了
headline.en: America votes, and AI's bill comes due

lede.zh: 昨天，美国人投票决定国会归属，特朗普剩下两年的政治空间就此揭晓；与此同时，美伊一边空袭一边谈判，霍尔木兹海峡的命运或在两天内见分晓。AI 世界则迎来一次“对账”：Anthropic 晒出 170 亿美元季度收入，也晒出更深的亏损，科技巨头 3.2 万亿美元的隐形承诺让市场开始紧张。
lede.en: Yesterday Americans voted on who controls Congress — and how much room Trump has for his final two years — while the US and Iran traded strikes and offers, with the Strait of Hormuz's fate possibly clear within two days. In AI it was a day of reckoning: Anthropic showed $17 billion in quarterly revenue alongside deeper losses, and $3.2 trillion in Big Tech's hidden AI commitments put markets on edge.
